Someone kept by name: his number or UPI ID, and an invite to his phone. His
book keeps working by name until he says yes; then his history is his.
B0. He scanned the shop's udhaar QR: he is at the counter.

get.description:
What happened to his scan. Once the shopkeeper records an amount, the entry
comes back here and his phone shows the confirmation sheet.

post.description: He tapped Cancel.
B1. "Yes, I owe ₹200".
B1. "That's not right".
Words typed or tapped: the same rules as speech, without the recogniser.

A recording from the shop's mic. 503 when voice is offline and it isn't a
recording we have heard before; the screen then asks him to type it.
`before`: what he said before, when this answers "कितने रुपये?".
His answer to "किसके लिए?", typed: who, among `among` (empty: the book).

His answer to "किसके लिए?", spoken. `among`: the customer ids offered,

get.description:
The amount said back in Sarvam's voice. An amount only: this route cannot
say a name. 503 when voice is offline and it was never spoken; the screen then
uses the browser's own voice.

The Soundbox when money arrives: "सौ रुपये मिले, सौ रुपये बाकी।" Amounts
only: this route cannot say a name. 503 when voice is offline and it was never
spoken; the Soundbox then plays its tone.

"किसके लिए?" (who), "कितने रुपये?" (how_much), "उधार या जमा?" (kind) or
"फिर से बोलिए।" (again), in Sarvam's voice.

post.description: He typed to the munshi.
He spoke to the munshi. The book's names are Saaras's hints.

He tapped हाँ, or the three-second countdown ran out. Saving twice is saving
once.
He tapped नहीं: the card goes, nothing is written.

get.description:
The munshi's reply in Sarvam's voice (Bulbul, shreya). 503 when voice is
offline; the screen then shows the reply without saying it.
C1. Every thread, the latest first, with what is unread.

post.description: Mark all read.

get.description: C3. His thread, as the shop sees it.

post.description: The shopkeeper writes to him. Words only: a message carries no amount.

Replies the munshi would send, in his language. Only suggestions: the
shopkeeper taps one to send it. None when voice is off.

C2. The right amount for an entry he says is wrong: a new entry, which he
confirms on his own phone. The disputed one is kept, and counts for nothing.

get.description:
V7. What happened since `after`: for the Soundbox's tones and the screen's
news. The first call (no `after`) only says what time it is.
C2. His thread with one shop.

post.description: He writes to the shop.

get.description: B2. What he owes across every shop, each entry, and invitations waiting.

post.description:
B3. He paid this shop by UPI: everything he owes it, or the part he chose.
Paytm moves the money; the book records which entries it paid, oldest first,
and the shop is told with what is still open.
He said yes to the shop's invite, on his own phone.

get.description:
Whose phone the customer side can be, for the demo: every customer with a
Paytm account in any shop's book, once each, and the synthetic accounts in
nobody's book yet. Someone kept by name only has no phone, so is not here.

schema.title: Response Demo Phones Demo Phones Get

get.description: A3. Tomorrow's list, as the book stands now. Writes nothing.

post.description:
The 11 pm run: works out the list and has the munshi write each reminder
not yet written. Running it again changes nothing already written.
Sends the reminders whose hour has come. n8n calls this (V8a).
The demo's fast-forward: every planned reminder goes now.
The shopkeeper said no to this one.
He changed his mind: it goes after all.

AccountOut.title: AccountOut
AccountOut.description: The Paytm account behind a number or UPI ID. The number is not kept.

AnswerOut.title: AnswerOut
AnswerOut.description:
Who the answer names, or the question again. The amount is the one already
heard; nothing is recorded yet.

CardOut.title: CardOut
CardOut.description:
The entry the munshi proposed, as the card shows it. The amount is the one
stored on the draft, never the munshi's sentence.

CheckOut.title: CheckOut
CheckOut.description: One check our code made on the reading.

CounterOut.title: CounterOut
CounterOut.description: Everyone at the counter, oldest scan first.

CustomerDetailOut.title: CustomerDetailOut
CustomerDetailOut.description:
One customer, as the shop keeps him: what it calls him, whether he is on
BAHI, what he owes, and his entries.

EventOut.title: EventOut
EventOut.description:
Something the shop should hear about. The Soundbox plays a tone, or says
an amount; it never says a name. The screen shows who.

HeardIn.title: HeardIn
HeardIn.description: What the shopkeeper said, typed or tapped instead of spoken.

HeardOut.title: HeardOut
HeardOut.description:
What was heard, what read it, and what our checks made of it. Nothing is
recorded yet.

JoinIn.title: JoinIn
JoinIn.description: He scanned the udhaar QR. A first-timer tells us the name to use.

LinkIn.title: LinkIn
LinkIn.description: His mobile number or UPI ID, for someone kept by name. Never stored.

MunshiIn.title: MunshiIn
MunshiIn.description: His words, typed. No conversation_id: a new conversation.

PayIn.title: PayIn
PayIn.description: He pays this shop by UPI: what he owes it, or the part he chose.

ReadbackOut.title: ReadbackOut
ReadbackOut.description: The amount said back. Never a name: the Soundbox says only the amount.

RecordIn.title: RecordIn
RecordIn.description: An udhaar entry. Either a scan (he is at the counter) or a customer.

RepliesOut.title: RepliesOut
RepliesOut.description: Replies the munshi suggests. Only offered: nothing is sent until he taps.
